name_input: M/S MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC INDIA PVT LTD; MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC INDIA PRIVATE LTD; MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC INDIA PVT. LTD.; MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC INDIA PVT LTD; MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC INDIA PVT LTD ; MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC INDIA PVT LTD
export_evidence: No outbound (export) shipment row was found. The only customs rows retrieved are inbound to India, e.g. ImportKey row: "2026-02-28 | MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC CONSUMER PRODUCTS (THAILAND) C | MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | E224N3452 (H) CONTROL P.C.BOARD ... | Laem Chabang, THAILAND | IRUNGATTUKOTTAI ICD INILP6, India | 84159000 | 7798583" — direction is Thailand -> India, i.e. an import, not an export. Source counter: ImportKey page for slug 'mitsubishi-electric-india-private-limited' states "Total Shipments 95396 Records detected", "Trading Partners 198", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually visible on the free page = 5 (all imports, HS 84159000). Second slug 'mitsubishi-electric-india-pvt-ltd' returned 5 visible US-customs rows, all imports of air conditioners HS 841509 into Chennai (BOLs BKK3CCC08100, BKK3CC09H200, BKK3C3929H00, BKK3C07B3H00), dated 2022-08-01..2022-09-28. Third slug 'mitsubishi-electric-india-pvt-ltd-' returned an empty record table (0 rows). No export bill-of-lading with an Indian-origin port and a foreign destination was observed for this entity.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India revenue split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com and trademo.com returned HTTP 403, volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, and the web_search backend failed on every call ("searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>"). The only India-side fact observed is the registered address on ImportKey: "M-38/1 MIDDLE CIRCLE CONNAUGHT PLACE" (Delhi) and a plant address "SURVEY NO.78/2B3, 78/2A1C,78/2A2C,ORAKADU ROAD,SHOLAVARAM,PONNERI TALUK,THIRUVALLUR DISTRICT" — addresses are not supply evidence. Domestic turnover: null (not public in the sources reachable).
note: Legal entity MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED is active and clearly real: it appears as a consignee in Indian customs data with 95,396 import records and a latest record dated 2026-02-28, so it is not a shell. However, per Rule 5 the question is actual shipments, and what is documented is inbound trade only — the company imports air conditioners and spare parts (HS 8415/84159000) from Mitsubishi Electric Consumer Products (Thailand) and Mitsubishi Electric Corporation (Japan). No export shipment with date, destination, HS code and B/L number was found, hence export_status = none_found rather than 'declared'. Domestic supply evidence could not be checked at all because every registry/aggregator and the search backend were unreachable (403 / connection refused), so domestic_status = unknown, not 'none_found' — absence here reflects a tooling gap, not a finding. HS note: declared HS 850440 (static converters) does not match the observed trade, which is HS 8415 (air conditioning) and 84159000 (AC parts); per Rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the actual code should be corrected to 8415/84159000. Industry 'Энергетика' is only partly consistent: the entity also sells factory automation, elevators and semiconductors, but the customs record shows consumer AC. Revenue and export volume: null — no public figure obtained, not estimated.
